title: One subject, many observers
purpose: Explain one-to-many dependency and automatic notification on state change.
alt: 하나의 Subject 상태 변화가 여러 등록 Observer의 자동 알림·갱신으로 이어지는 일대다 관계
requiredChecks: One Subject owns state and has many registered observers.
Example state 2 reaches Cat, Dog, Mouse through update(2).
Observer dependency and notification direction are distinguished.
No guaranteed notification ordering or independent observer source of state.
